SELECT p.sku, string_agg(DISTINCT p.product_name, ' / ') AS names, string_agg(DISTINCT p.category,'/') AS cats, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS fact_units_exZZ,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')  AS x,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS days

WITH t AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
   AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, t.units_sold
FROM t JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=t.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY t.units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 3
